description: Parking Lot Facilities is a dataset listed in City of Toronto open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Toronto. This dataset includes data on parking lots operated by the City of Toronto PF&R Division. Parking lots are located in parks or on the building grounds of community centres, schools, pool buildings, etc. These buildings or parks are considered parent assets of parking lots and listed in 'Park Name' column. Coverage: Toronto. The portal files it under the publisher City of Toronto. Its tags are parking lot. It offers 2 resource(s) in XLSX. The portal shows 2022-03-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is open-government-licence-toronto. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-toronto-portal.
